capabilities.justification: Reads the crate's vos.toml and warrant/impl.part, the contract package's vos.toml, contract.vos and warrant/*.part, and the document under code/specs, each bounded by a byte cap, regular files only, never following a symlink.
gen-doc writes exactly one file, code/specs/<impl>.warrant, through a fresh temporary file in the same directory and a rename; it refuses a symlink or non-regular file at the target.
Lists the entries of the contract package's warrant directory and the implementation's, at most 64 each, to compare the tier files with contract.vos.
Removes only its own temporary file (.<impl>.warrant.vos-link.tmp) when a write fails.
Reads the command-line arguments and the working directory (canonicalised) to resolve the crate path.
Prints the report to standard output and a no-verdict reason to standard error.
Reported by the analyzer for std::process::ExitCode, which only sets the exit status; the program spawns no process.
Runs the Warrant analysis on one thread with a 256 MiB stack (backlog VOS-D057); the thread is joined before the result is used.

justification: A document generator and checker: reads the files of one implementation and its contract package, writes one generated document. No network and no subprocess.
